# Code Anchors: Back Navigation

- `src/app/history.tsx` — keeps the record of history entries seen and decides how an up control moves
- `src/app/UpButton.tsx` — the on-screen up control
- `src/app/scrollMemory.ts` — keeps and restores a page's scroll position per history entry
- `src/pages/ListPage.tsx` — restores the list's scroll position on return
- `src/components/NotFound.tsx` — carries an up control to the parent page
